items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, that happen later on with Arturo Sandolval.

ctx.x: So did you get the sense that after you left, after you defected that they began to watch the members of that band more closely, to make sure that didn’t happen again?
Well, that happen later on with Arturo Sandolval. That is inevitable; it is very hard to control that. You know what is the definition of a string quartet?
